toegepas.rede_vinder: A word discussed as a word is marked with quotation marks so the learner reads it as the term.
toegepas.fout: A word discussed as a word is not marked, so 'klassiek' reads as part of the sentence rather than as the term being explained.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Quotation marks around a word cited as a word are standard Afrikaans practice and change nothing in the meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The idiomatic Afrikaans form is 'al vier die ...', as in 'al drie die kinders'.
toegepas.fout: 'al vier families' leaves out the article that the fixed Afrikaans pattern 'al vier die ...' requires.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Al vier die families' is the natural idiom; same four families, same meaning.

toegepas.blok: Kwaito en klassieke musiek langs mekaar
toegepas.na: sintetiseerder gemaak, en klassieke musiek dikwels
toegepas.rede_vinder: The bare comma joining the two halves reads as a comma splice; 'en' links them, as in the Genre item.
toegepas.fout: The bare comma between the two halves reads abruptly, and it is the only comparison item without a linking word.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'en' links the halves the way the Genre and Stemme items already do, and leaves the protected 'meestal' and the qualifier 'dikwels' intact.

toegepas.na: Gebruik die woorde uit hierdie les
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die les se woorde' is wooden; 'die woorde uit hierdie les' is the natural phrasing.
toegepas.fout: 'die les se woorde' is a stiff possessive for a lesson's vocabulary.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die woorde uit hierdie les' is what a fluent writer would say and means the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: After a noun of time such as 'oomblik' the relative 'waarop' is the correct linker, not the conjunction 'wanneer'.
toegepas.fout: 'die oomblik wanneer jy' uses the conjunction 'wanneer' as a relative after a time noun, which copies English 'the moment when'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Waarop' is the correct relative after 'oomblik', a plain grammar fix that keeps the protected label 'By 'n sprong:' and the meaning.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Afrikaans prefers the compound 'musiektradisie' over the English-shaped 'tradisie van musiek'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n Tradisie van musiek' is English-shaped where Afrikaans uses the compound 'musiektradisie'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fix is a rewording of a glossary definition, not a spelling or grammar error, so it goes to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Kwaito en klassieke musiek langs mekaar
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: gegroei, en klassieke musiek in Europa
laat_vaar_vorige.na: gegroei en klassieke musiek in Europa
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The second half has no verb of its own (elliptic), so under the AWS rule as applied here no comma goes before 'en'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The gapped second half is still a contrasting clause and the comma reads well; removing it is not clearly better.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: oor jou eie en ander groepe se optredes
laat_vaar_vorige.na: oor jou groep en ander groepe se optredes
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Jou eie en ander groepe se' does not parse cleanly (own what?); naming the group matches the block heading and its last sentence; one word more.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'jou eie en ander groepe se optredes' is a normal Afrikaans ellipsis, and 'jou groep' narrows 'jou eie', so the change is lateral at best.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: tromklanke maak en oor en oor speel
laat_vaar_vorige.na: tromklanke maak en dit oor en oor speel
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Speel' needs an object here, otherwise it reads as if the machine itself plays; one word more.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: In a glossary definition, 'oor en oor speel' without an object is acceptable Afrikaans for a device that plays repeatedly, so there is no real fault to fix.
